title.narrative: Purchase / Sale of Emission Reductions (ER) to be generated under the Mai Ndombe ER Program

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to make payments to the Recipient for measured, reported and verified Emission Reductions related to reduced deforestation, forest degradation and the enhancement of forest carbon stocks (ER payments) in the Mai-Ndombe province, and to distribute ER payments in accordance with the agreed Benefit Sharing Plan.
